items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I bought this instrument from this boy, Bob Rand recommended it to it

ctx.x: A lot of things. You were going to tell about another clarinetist you thought of?

Yes. Uh, this other clarinet. Now, let me see if that's the one I bought by Peterson or the one I got from, uh, well, I guess it matters. It don't matter which place I got it from. It's Noble. Noble. Noble, yes. Oh, Noble. Yeah. Never heard of that. That's a, that's a BEM you're speaking about. It's a BEM, yes. Um, BEMs and Noble and all. The other one I can't remember now, but I might remember the name before we finish. Well, anyhow. Uh, so let me, right now I have three clarinets. What are you still doing?…
Uh, you were mentioning about, uh, Papa Salastain, uh, knocking out with the, uh, two-by-four. Did he do that in later years when you joined the band?
